one_experiment.priority: Measure frozen lexical embedding baseline before expanding graph architecture. GNN topology is not universal pretrained language or bank-policy knowledge.
one_experiment.features: Reuse signed SHA256 word/bigram/character3gram hashing from day2_public_model_v2.keys/sparse, width512, add only local speaker/node-type keys. No source labels, IDs, domain labels, gold spans or targets in inputs. Preserve empty turns and all context text; reject rather than silently clip unsupported sizes.
one_experiment.graph: Single turns keep whole-turn+up-to3 balanced text spans. Taskmaster uses up-to6 observed context turns+summary. Directed membership, source_order, observed_next_turn matrices only. No invented correction/coreference/policy edges.

equations.encoder: h0_i=tanh(x_i E+bE); h1_i=tanh(h0_i Wself+bm+sum_r mean_{j:(j,i,r)} h0_j Wr). Empty relation contributes0. No-edge control deletes nonself messages only; same initialization, schedule, heads and pooling.
equations.pooling: Single-turn: ordered-span mean. Taskmaster:0.5last_context+0.5last_user (context mean if no user). Sparse uses same context pooling before linear decoder.
equations.masked_loss: ell_i,h=sum_k m_ik BCE(z_ik,y_ik)/max(1,sum_k m_ik); false mask is unknown, not negative. B77 uses source CE.
equations.group_loss: L_s,h=mean_over_supported_groups(mean_over_supported_rows(ell_i,h)); equal group mass, especially Taskmaster24TRAIN components.
equations.Taskmaster: y=normalized signed-hash512(actual next assistant response); u=normalize(p Wnext+bnext,epsilon1e-8); L_TM=||u-y||^2. This is lexical response representation, not generation or policy gold. Equal scrubbed responses are not false negative classes.
equations.teacher: Freeze local MiniLM384 normalized attention-mean embeddings. Fresh77/62/17 readouts fitted only on our corresponding TRAIN masks. Classification comparator omits Taskmaster loss.
equations.later_distillation: Only after measured lexical benefit, separate frozen TRAIN-only experiment:0.75hard+0.25tau^2KL(teacher||student),tau2; masked BernoulliKL for multilabel. Never fit CAL/EVAL pseudo-labels. Not executed or automatically approved here.

schedule.optimizer: Adam lr0.01 batch128; deterministic source/group/row sampling; fresh weights; same G/no-edge batches

limits.timeout: partial/unscored status; never silently reschedule after EVAL

calibration_evaluation.split_roots: Preserve split/group_id/conversation_root_ids and all descendants. No heldout fitting or frozen packet edits.
calibration_evaluation.CAL: Before outcomes, SHA256(group_id) parity partitions each source into disjoint temperature-fit and threshold-select groups. B77 existing496/497. Compute others before calibration; no within-conversation split.
calibration_evaluation.temperature: One scalar per head grid[0.5,0.75,1,1.5,2,3] on masked CAL-fit CE/BCE; no per-rare-class adaptive calibrator.
calibration_evaluation.threshold: B77 existing fixed grid/rule; NLUpp global0.5 baseline plus per-head grid[0.3,0.5,0.7,0.9,1.1] maximizing masked microF1 on CAL-select, tie higher. Absent-positive CAL labels have unknown calibration support; no precision certificate.
calibration_evaluation.EVAL: Freeze all transforms/weights/calibrators before one aggregate run. Already exposed internal EVAL stays exploratory/adaptive research, even if this individual run is frozen. Fresh policy qualification requires actual new data after freeze.
metrics: paired G/noedge correctness disagreements, not only4netrows
Taskmaster group cosine/MSE and fixed latest-only/order-role controls
calibration_evaluation.denominators: Exclude unknown masked labels from relevant estimands and report their counts; no negative padding. Accepted source precision denominator is accepted examples/groups, not all rows. Marginal scores are not a joint correctness probability.
calibration_evaluation.negative_control: If time permits, TRAIN-only whole-group donor permutation within source/domain preserving masks/aliases; no rowwise split leakage. Main fits must not wait for optional control.
calibration_evaluation.risk: No OOD or bank-safety bound from in-domain source CAL. Exact one-sided group bounds need genuinely independent frozen qualification groups and multiplicity control; current publisher/template counts do not prove assumptions.

QA_limits.other_limits: QA lists additional paraphrase/answer-like families and secret/numeric scrubbing semantic loss. Preserve results; future whole-family quarantine needs source evidence/new manifest, not current label rewrites or EVAL tuning.
QA_limits.NLUpp_marker_leak: build-v2 spans_scrub replaces gold slot spans with REDACTED_ENTITY. Slot presence may exploit annotation-derived markers unavailable in raw runtime. Report placeholder-only and fixed placeholder-neutral feature controls; keep original frozen rows/labels unchanged. Sanitized-domain scores do not establish raw slot extraction.

portable.format: finite JSON+base64 little-endianfloat32 arrays; stdlib base64/struct/math/hashlib/re only. Int8 per-output-column optional after measured probability/logit parity. No pickle/joblib/remote code.
portable.teacher: 22.7M MiniLM encoder cannot fit500KB. Offline comparator/teacher only; never count head-only bytes as complete inference.
portable.platform: fixedAGENT_LLM and banktools remain live authority. No external embedding API, endpoint, inference tool or added banktools.
